rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORlyn
Exhibition name: Lynette
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, before 1983).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 1983 as 'Lynette'.
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1985 as 'Lynette'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, coral-pink edges. None / no fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: Zimbabwe patent application No. 8833 on April 25, 1988
